regions.today: Sunny spells this evening and just a few showers in the north of Leinster.
regions.tonight: Tonight will start off mainly dry with clear spells. Showers will develop later tonight. Lowest temperatures of 5 to 8 degrees with moderate to fresh westerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Wednesday will be a cool, breezy day with sunshine and showers. Highest temperatures of 11 to 13 degrees with fresh, gusty northwesterly winds.
